{{Quote|Congratulations. You've drawn janitorial duty. Big Gyyl, consider yourself a trustee.|[[Moruth Doole]], to [[Gyylghrard]]|<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030501kessel|text=Kessel: Hell in Space|int=Kessel: Hell in Space}}</ref>}}
[[File:Kadir11.jpg|thumb|During the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Kadir (Tarisian)|Kadir]] was a janitor in the [[Upper City]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].]]
A '''janitor''', also referred to as a '''custodian''', or more formally as a '''Custodial Officer''', was a person who took care of a building, such as an educational facility, an office building, or a residential apartment block; or a military [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Janitors were responsible primarily for cleaning. Sometimes the duties of a janitor were performed by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>
